title: 第23章 魔鬼的植物第24章 觉醒领主天赋
slug: 领主我在苦痛世界养成少女
content_zh:
“哎？”阿诗娜还没反应过来。
菲尔德扑在阿诗娜身上，将脸埋到她的脖子处，独属于神选者的幽香沁入心脾。
然后，菲尔德狠狠的，贴了下去。
腰肢柔软纤细，盈盈一握。
“大人，别这样！”阿诗娜感觉到脖颈湿热的吐气，慌张地左右乱看，嘴上这么说，却没有用力推开。
她甚至需要控制身体内强横的神力，否则暴动的神力，可能会伤到自己的领主。
感受到菲尔德细腻灼热的舌挢，“轻拢慢捻抹复挑”，阿诗娜当即感觉脊背一丝酥麻，双腿发软。下一刻，菲尔德就把另一只手，往奇怪的地方摸去。
“事情怎么会发展成这样！”
阿诗娜哭笑不得，她需要抵抗身上传来的愉悦感，还得控制神力，防止暴走。
一心两用，反倒让她更敏感。
眼看就要开盖即食。
好在，阿诗娜轻咬舌尖，让大脑获得了一丝清明，身形快速后退。
“唔，感觉很舒服，不对！太奇怪了吧！”
毕竟太过分的内容，大家都不爱看。
“那个植物有问题，灰雾之中，果然只会有魔鬼的东西。”
阿诗娜后悔不已，早知道就烧掉那可疑的东西。
“菲尔德大人！你在哪？”卫兵们发现菲尔德不在村庄中心，已经焦急万分的找过来了。
“天呐！”阿诗娜娇羞的脸上，立刻出现了慌张。
慌张之下，愉悦感全无，阿诗娜立刻抽出手，催动神力点在菲尔德的眉心。纯洁的神力，立刻驱散了魔法植物的药性。
“额，好晕。”

菲尔德扶着脑袋，逐渐清醒过来，心中的兽欲被理智压住。睁眼却看到阿诗娜夹着腿，脸红得快要滴出水，但还要佯装看风景的样子。
“我没事。”
卫兵找了过来，菲尔德摆摆手，示意他先出去等着。
“我好像还没研究那个小青菜。”皱起眉头，菲尔德感觉这件事好像干过，甩了下酸软的手臂，当即俯下身，伸手就要摘一个做样本，“所以，这是魔法植物吗？”
“别！凛冬女神在上。”阿诗娜都快傻了，这再来一次，自己未必把持得住，自己回去甚至得换条裙子，哪能让菲尔德再如此折腾，“您刚才研究过了，这种植物非常危险。”
阿诗娜无奈，将刚才发生的一切，凑到菲尔德耳边，悄声说了出来。
“好变态的植物。”菲尔德震惊，但随后叹了口气，“可惜了，我完全没有记忆。”
content_en:
"Huh?" Asheina hasn't reacted yet.
Field threw himself on Asheena, burying his face in her neck, and the fragrance that belonged only to the Chosen One filled his heart.
Then, Field pressed it hard.
The waist is soft and slender, and can be grasped.
"Sir, don't do this!" Asuna felt the hot and moist breath on her neck. She looked around in a panic and said this, but did not push away hard.
She even needs to control the powerful divine power in her body, otherwise the rioting divine power may hurt her lord.
Feeling Field's delicate and hot tongue, "lightly close, slowly twisting and then lifting", Asuna immediately felt a numbness on her back and her legs were weak. The next moment, Field touched the strange place with his other hand.
"How could things develop like this!"
Ashina didn't know whether to laugh or cry. She needed to resist the pleasure coming from her body, and she also had to control her divine power to prevent going berserk.
Doing two things made her more sensitive.
It’s time to open the lid and eat immediately.
Fortunately, Asheena bit the tip of her tongue, gaining some clarity in her brain, and retreated quickly.
"Well, it feels very comfortable, no! It's too weird!"
After all, no one likes to read content that is too extreme.
"There's something wrong with that plant. In the gray mist, there are only devilish things."
Ashina regretted it so much that she would have burned the suspicious thing if she had known it.
"Lord Field! Where are you?" The guards found that Field was not in the center of the village and came over anxiously.
"Oh my god!" Panic immediately appeared on Asheina's shy face.
In panic, her sense of pleasure was gone, and Asheina immediately pulled out her hand and tapped her divine power on Field's eyebrows. The pure divine power immediately dispelled the medicinal properties of the magic plants.
"Uh, I feel so dizzy."
Field held his head and gradually came to his senses. The animalistic desires in his heart were suppressed by reason. When he opened his eyes, he saw Ashina with her legs crossed and her face red to the point of dripping, but she still pretended to look at the scenery.
"I'm fine."
The guard came over, and Field waved his hand, motioning for him to go out and wait.
"It seems I haven't studied that little green vegetable yet." Frowning, Field felt as if he had done this before. He shook off his sore arms and immediately leaned down, reaching out to pick one for a sample. "So, is this a magic plant?"
"No! The Goddess of Winter is here." Asuna was almost dumbfounded. She might not be able to control it again. She even had to change a skirt when she went back. How could she let Field go through such trouble again, "You have just studied this plant. This plant is very dangerous."
Asheina had no choice but to whisper everything that had just happened to Field's ear.
"What a perverted plant." Field was shocked, but then sighed, "It's a pity, I have no memory at all."
